title: Random Stuff (W.I.P)
description: this mod adds a lot of random stuff
body:
randomstuff

i made a mod. it has stuff in it. some of it is cool i think.

i made this with MCreator



items:



Eye Of Lightning – throwable eye. does lightning stuff

Eye Of Doom – also throwable. will probably explode you

Broken Eye Of Doom – you broke it. there's an advancement for that

Eye Of Yumm – you can eat this one. gives you "Yummy!" effect. normal food

Sword Of Ultimate Power – the name carries it

Stabby – its stabby

Laser Shooter – shoots lasers. needs Laserr (two r's)

Laserr – the ammo. yes two r's

Berry – a berry

Plant – internally named plantttttttttttttttttttttttttttttttttt because i held down t

Boxing Gloves – chestplate. they're gloves but minecraft said chestplate so ok

Oil Bucket – bucket of oil

Plastic – plastic

Proceser – the item id is literally just d



blocks:



Oil – liquid. it's oil

Boxsack – block

Berry Plant – grows berries i think

D – a block called d



mobs:



Evil Computer Eye Guy – computer + eye + evil. detects vibrations so it knows you're there. i spent time on the model

some projectile entities that fly around and hurt you



effects:



Sick – bad

Yummy! – from eating the eye of yumm. probably good



there's also like 4 variants of Potion of Sickness because i was committed



advancements:



The Eye – craft the eye of ligthning (yes ligthning)

Throw away doom – "you throwed the eye of doom" (yes throwed)

You broke it! – break the eye of doom

Realy? An Eye – eat the yumm eye



other:

there's a Useless GUI. it has a close button and says "lol". that's it.

keybinds: lol, Useless gui, and Miku. i don't know what miku does either



NeoForge 1.21.8 – don't expect balance



























(to be honest this description was made using ai, the mod adds way to much stuff for me to be able to create a description myself. Sorry)
